definition: This dimension controls the resources required to identify items, which can range from using in-game currency, consumables, or even time spent in-game. Variations can lead to differing levels of risk and strategy regarding item usage.
exclusion_criteria: All items are identified upon acquisition.
inclusion_criteria: Identification requires a specific resource like gold or items.
Identification can involve a skill check or character attribute.
title: Identification Cost Variation
